Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities in Remote Desktop Services (RDS) allowing wormable malware propagation
Exploitation via specially crafted requests to Remote Desktop Service via RDP
Propagation from vulnerable computer to vulnerable computer without user interaction
Impacted Systems: All supported versions of Windows 10 including server versions
Attack Vector: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) connection with specially crafted requests
Pre-authentication exploitation requiring no user interaction
Indicators of Compromise: Scanner module for discovering BlueKeep-vulnerable Windows computers found in Watchbog malware variant
BlueKeep RCE exploit included in Immunity CANVAS automated pentesting utility version 7.23
Microsoft advisories and patches for CVE-2019-1181, CVE-2019-1182, and CVE-2019-0708
